name: Disneyland Docking Bay 7 Smoked Kaadu Pork Ribs / Pulled Pork & Corn Muffin
brandOrRestaurant: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Slow-smoked country pork ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender; skipping the raw cabbage slaw and pairing with the soft blueberry corn muffin works well on a steady day.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the tender interior pork meat and soft muffin, leaving the raw purple cabbage slaw behind.
watchOuts: Skip the raw cabbage slaw and heavy smoky BBQ glaze edges during sensitive periods
